items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Sunday vs Rams due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Sit Smith; elevates other Eagles pass-catchers in high-powered offense vs Rams.
items.opportunity: More targets/snaps for remaining WRs/TE in PHI.

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson ruled out Sunday vs Dolphins due to sprained ankle; did not practice all week.
items.why: Sprained ankle from prior game; full week DNP.
items.implication: Sit Jefferson; target Addison/other Vikings pass-catchers as fill-ins.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Jordan Addison and secondary WRs.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels ruled out again (elbow); Marcus Mariota starts vs Colts in London.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow; limited practice but not ready; optimistic for Week 5.
items.implication: Sit Daniels; Mariota is viable streamer vs IND.
items.opportunity: Full snaps for Mariota; McLaurin Q with hamstring.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday vs Bears.
items.why: Quadriceps injury from Week 3; week-to-week, no practice.
items.implication: Sit Hall; handcuff/backup becomes RB2+ play vs CHI.
items.opportunity: Workhorse/lead back snaps and carries shift to backup RB.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is off the injury report and good to go Sunday vs Titans.
items.implication: Start Jackson with full dual-threat upside.
items.opportunity: Normal rush/pass volume and red-zone usage.

items.text: Nico Collins is good to go for Texans vs Cowboys.
items.why: Friday injury/game status report clears him (prior hamstring).
items.implication: Start Collins as WR1; full target share expected.

items.text: Aaron Donald out (back) vs Eagles; Puka Nacua expected to play (hip).
items.why: Full practices; coach confirmation of no designation expected.
items.implication: Start Nacua with confidence after missing prior games; monitor workload.
items.opportunity: Full route/target share return for Nacua; Donald absence may help PHI run/pass protection.

items.text: With Dylan Sampson (knee) out virtually all season, Quinshon Judkins has seen solid 13.8% target share (vs 8.3% prior); on pace for 64 catches.
items.why: Teammate absence driving higher receiving role in small sample.
items.implication: Judkins elevated as pass-catching RB; higher PPR floor/ceiling ROS.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE (TNF): 90% snap rate last week, 20 of 22 RB touches with Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ yards to RBs every game.
items.why: Elite usage/volume + soft matchup; Dowdle out again.
items.implication: Strong RB2/WR1-flex start; top-10 play potential.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: Low utilization (RB27), 3.5% target share, 25% routes, snaps down to 42% W3, only 13% third downs; SEA stout vs run (2.9 YPC).
items.opportunity: Low route/target/third-down share signals restricted role.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% career tgt share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share last week (9-194); NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Proven high-volume chemistry with Penix + soft secondary.
items.opportunity: Dominant target share and red-zone opportunities.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI: Mitchell likely out again; prior 36% tgt share without him; 78% catch rate, 9.0 YPT; CHI allows 14+ YPR.
items.why: Elevated role with teammate absence + favorable matchup.
items.opportunity: Target monopoly and efficiency in favorable slot/outside matchup.

items.text: HATE Kyle Pitts @ NO: Just 16% tgt share/34 rec ypg career with Penix; under 8 FP in 9/13 such games; TE37 utilization this year.
items.opportunity: Low target share and aDOT underperformance.

items.text: Fresh ETR ROS Top-150 live: Kenneth Walker ranked 3 overall; other notables Parker Washington 22, Saquon Barkley 30.
items.why: Updated for roles/injuries/schedule if season started today.
items.implication: Walker elite ROS hold/buy; adjust trade values accordingly.
